name: Qdrant (self-operated software)
description: Self-operated software release, not a hosted-service plan. Canonical metrics are supported families; score transforms and representation-specific limits remain in the linked research note. Runtime configuration, access enforcement and operational costs require separate evidence.

provenance.notes: Distance enum establishes Cosine, Euclid and Dot (also Manhattan, outside canonical v1 metric vocabulary).
VectorParams validates dense size in 1..65536; sparse and multivector representation limits are separate, so no universal max_dimensions is asserted.
Collection-level role modes exist. Legacy payload constraints are rejected as deprecated. No deployment ACL guarantee is asserted.

Apache-2.0 software license. No-charge software use is distinct from hosting, storage and operations costs; comply with license/NOTICE and redistribution conditions. No customer-content or hosted-service rights inferred.
Publisher release/tag pin resolves to commit 016542aa5deb6c66380bb137badf73d54f742bde. No installed runtime or benchmark was exercised.
